title: Minnesota Mystery: 11-Foot Metal Object Found in Cornfield; Is It SpaceX Rocket Debris, Satellite Fragments or a UFO? Check What Happened in Scott Township
excerpt: An 11-foot-wide metal object with a scorched underside and jagged edges was discovered in a Minnesota cornfield.
content:
A mysterious metal object measuring around 11 feet wide has been discovered in a cornfield in Scott Township, Minnesota, leaving local police and investigators searching for answers.

The hollow, bowl-shaped object reportedly has jagged edges and scorch marks on its underside. The Stevens County Sheriff’s Office said multiple state and federal agencies are working to identify the debris and locate its owner. Authorities have reportedly stated that there is no danger to the public.

What Happened in Scott Township, Minnesota?

A passerby spotted the unusual object at around 3:30 p.m. on Wednesday and alerted the Stevens County Sheriff’s Office. Officers responded to the scene to examine the debris.

You Might Be Interested In

Measuring about 11 feet across and roughly the size of a large hot tub, the metal structure appears to have broken away from a larger object. Its origin has not yet been publicly confirmed.

Is the Mysterious Object Space Debris?

One theory circulating online is that the object could be part of a rocket or a disintegrating satellite. The discovery came amid reports of a SpaceX rocket launch from Florida on Tuesday, prompting speculation about a possible connection.

However, there is no confirmed evidence linking the object to SpaceX or any particular spacecraft. Investigators will need to examine its material, design, and other identifying features before establishing its origin.

Did a Tornado Cause the Object to Fall?

Another theory suggests the debris could be connected to a tornado that reportedly passed through the Minnesota region several weeks earlier.

The object’s jagged edges have fuelled questions about whether it was torn from a larger structure. However, no official findings have established a link to the tornado, and the theory remains unverified.

Social Media Users Wonder Whether It Is a UFO

The discovery has triggered speculation on Reddit and Facebook, with users suggesting everything from rocket fragments to extraterrestrial activity.

One Reddit user asked, “Did SpaceX explode again???” Another suggested it could be rocket debris, while a commenter jokingly called for Elon Musk to receive a littering ticket.

Others questioned why there was no visible crater, while some raised concerns about possible radiation. One person described the object as a flying saucer.

These comments reflect online speculation, not confirmed findings from investigators.

Is the Metal Object Dangerous?

The Stevens County Sheriff’s Office has reportedly said there is no danger to the public. However, the object’s composition and origin have not been officially identified.

Authorities and other agencies are continuing their investigation. Members of the public should avoid touching unidentified debris and follow any instructions issued by local authorities.

What Happens Next?

Investigators are working to identify the object and notify its owner. Until officials release further findings, it remains unclear whether the metal structure came from a rocket, satellite, another manufactured object, or an entirely different source.

For now, theories about SpaceX, tornado damage, and aliens remain unconfirmed as investigators try to solve the mystery.
